grade_semantics.S: All research/timing/admitted-evidence/edge/hard-block checks pass; request human review only.
grade_semantics.A: High research quality; price/timing/trigger/edge gate remains unmet; watch/wait.
grade_semantics.B: Logic/catalyst exists, but evidence/odds/risk/trend gaps remain; no active trade.
grade_semantics.X: Admitted hard block or explicit unmet strategy requirement.
